finding_summary: For Kafka 4.2.0, ListTransactionsOptions.filterProducerIds(empty) means no producer-ID filtering, not match-none. With the pinned Flink connector's kafka-clients 4.2.0 dependency and FE-511's AdminUtils observation, an empty derived active-producer set cannot by itself constrain the ListTransactions option layer to zero producers.
